correctness.rationale: An exact full-sphere two-point geodesic disintegration with absolute sine Jacobian is normalized and applied to the prohibited small cap. Opposing arc endpoints produce the exact integral 2(pi-2h-sin 2h). Both remaining trigonometric integrals are computed analytically, yielding conditional cubic t(1-t)^2/2. Differentiation gives unique maximum 2/27; endpoint and convex regimes are separately checked. A reproducible standard-library checker numerically evaluates independent quadrature and directly samples shortening-arc escape.
